text: Help me split a 10-page report into 30-minute work blocks.

I can help you divide the 10-page report into 30-minute work blocks. Here's a simple plan:

1. Determine your total working hours for the day.
2. Allocate a portion of those hours for the report (e.g., 4 hours if you work 8 hours a day).
3. Divide the total time by the number of pages (4 hours / 10 pages = 40 minutes per page).
4. Round up to the nearest 30 minutes (40 minutes = 40 minutes + 10 minutes = 50 minutes).
5. Adjust the total time to account for breaks (e.g., 4 hours - 2 15-minute breaks = 3 hours and 45 minutes).
6. Divide the adjusted total time by the number of 30-minute blocks you want (3 hours and 45 minutes / 3 = 1 hour and 15 minutes per block).
7. Now, you can distribute the pages across the work blocks.

Next step: Apply this plan to your 10-page report and start working!
